metadata.methodology: GIS Spatial Catchment Buffer Optimization & Micro-Demographic Allocation

districts.strategy: Angul (Central Industrial, Vulnerability Score: 60/100) currently features a Secondary education spatial coverage of 75.0%. Given its central plateau & coal basin landscape and 14.1% tribal population, the masterplan deploys 66 Upper Primary school upgrades to High Schools, 25 state-of-the-art greenfield Secondary campuses in unserved clusters, and 13 dedicated student transport and residential hostel hubs. This spatial intervention elevates secondary schooling access to 98.7% with an estimated capital and operational outlay of ₹121.0 Crores.
